# CoiPatrol

> CoiPatrol is certificate of insurance (COI) tracking software for small construction and property firms. Upload an ACORD 25 PDF, CoiPatrol reads the policy dates and limits, shows every subcontractor on a green, yellow and red dashboard, and emails renewal reminders automatically. Free for up to 10 subcontractors, $49 a month for up to 50, $99 a month for up to 150. 14-day trial on paid plans, two months off with annual billing. No sales call.

Limits, stated honestly: no carrier-direct policy verification, no managed review team, built for up to 150 subcontractors.

## Product
- [Home](https://coipatrol.com/): what CoiPatrol does and who it is for
- [Pricing](https://coipatrol.com/pricing/): public pricing, Free, $49 and $99 a month

## Free tools
- [Free COI tracking spreadsheet](https://coipatrol.com/free-coi-tracking-spreadsheet/): ungated Excel and Google Sheets template with red, yellow and green expiration rules
- [COI request email template](https://coipatrol.com/coi-request-email-template/): copy-and-paste request and renewal emails
